# device42_auto_discovery_certificate (Resource)


## Exemple

```hcl
resource "device42_auto_discovery_certificate" "myCertJob" {
   name         = "myCertJob"
   server       = "hostname.domain.local"
   ports        = "443"
   follow_chain = "yes"
}
```



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the certificate autodiscovery job. Create only (the API upserts by name).
- `server` (String) IP or FQDN of the target server.

### Optional

- `debug_level` (String) Debug level of the job.
- `end_ip_address` (String) End of the IP address range (legacy, prefer `server`).
- `exclude_servers` (String) Comma separated list of addresses to exclude.
- `follow_chain` (String) Whether to follow the certificate chain. Defaults to `no`.
- `get_cipher_suites` (String) Find cipher suites supported by the server.
- `ports` (String) Comma separated list of ports. Defaults to `443`.
- `schedule_days` (String) Comma separated days of week (Monday = 0).
- `schedule_time` (String) Time in HH:MM format to schedule the job.
- `start_ip_address` (String) Start of the IP address range (legacy, prefer `server`).
- `tags` (String) Comma separated list of tags to attach.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
